Fees and Funding
Eligible students in the funded cohort (MASc years 1–2; PhD years 1–4) each receive the unit’s normal funding package, which comprises both coverage of program fees and a living allowance as a single guaranteed minimum stipend amount that can be raised through a tiered system based on the (combined) value of external scholarships awarded to the student. The following clarifies the composition and sources of funding.
